# Enforce Interest

> Enforce Interest is a Rise Public Adjusting service (Texas public adjuster license #3356839) that documents late-paid Texas property insurance claims and calculates statutory interest under Texas Insurance Code §542.060: 18% a year for most claims, or the §304.003 judgment rate plus 5% (currently 12.00%, November 2026) for weather claims made on or after September 1, 2017.

Not a law firm; information is educational.

## Guides

- [The Texas Prompt Payment Act, explained](https://enforceinterest.com/texas-prompt-payment-act/): The Texas Prompt Payment Act (Ins. Code ch. 542) section by section: 15-day, 15-business-day, 5-day and 60-day deadlines, interest and key cases.
- [Hail & wind claims paid late](https://enforceinterest.com/hail-wind-claims/): Texas hail and wind claims paid late: deadlines, the 61-day 542A notice, the 12.00% floating interest rate, roof supplements and evidence.
- [Hurricane claims in Texas](https://enforceinterest.com/hurricane-claims/): Texas hurricane claims: private insurer deadlines and floating interest, TWIA's one-year, 60-day and 10-day rules, deductibles and wind vs. flood.
- [Fire & smoke damage claims](https://enforceinterest.com/fire-smoke-damage/): Texas fire and smoke damage claims paid late: the 18% interest rate, arson timing, smoke damage investigations, ACV holdbacks and contents.
- [Water & plumbing damage claims](https://enforceinterest.com/water-plumbing-damage/): Texas water and plumbing damage claims paid late: sudden vs. seepage, mold, freeze, the 18% interest rate and how to document a water claim.
- [The carrier paid the appraisal. The interest is a separate question.](https://enforceinterest.com/post-appraisal-interest-recovery/): Insurer paid the appraisal award but not the interest? How Hinojos and Rodriguez apply in Texas and how post-appraisal interest works.
- [The repair started. Then they found more damage.](https://enforceinterest.com/long-term-claim-supplements/): How Texas prompt-payment deadlines and interest apply to claim supplements: hidden damage, code upgrades and stacking interest.
- [Claim documentation toolkit](https://enforceinterest.com/claim-documentation-toolkit/): Recommended tools for documenting a Texas property insurance claim: moisture meters, thermal cameras, scanners, tarps and freeze protection.

## Tools

- [Does my claim qualify?](https://enforceinterest.com/does-my-claim-qualify/): Free two-minute check: does your Texas insurance claim qualify for prompt-payment interest under §542.060? Find out where you stand.
- [Texas statutory interest calculator](https://enforceinterest.com/statutory-damages-calculator/): Free Texas §542.060 statutory interest calculator: 18% or 12.00% floating rate, partial payments, supplements and a printable memo.
- [Texas insurance claim deadline calculator](https://enforceinterest.com/tools/claim-deadline-calculator/): Calculate every Texas Chapter 542 claim deadline from your notice date: 15 days, 15 business days, 5 business days, 60 days and more.
- [Appraisal interest calculator](https://enforceinterest.com/tools/appraisal-interest-calculator/): Calculate Texas prompt-payment interest on the gap between pre-appraisal payments and the award (Hinojos), and check for shortfalls.
- [542A notice and attorney fee calculator](https://enforceinterest.com/tools/542a-notice-calculator/): Texas Chapter 542A calculator: 61-day pre-suit notice dates, the 30-day inspection window and the §542A.007 attorney-fee ratio.
- [Claim timeline builder](https://enforceinterest.com/tools/claim-timeline-builder/): Log Texas insurance claim events, see the Chapter 542 deadlines they trigger, flag late payments and print a status-request letter.
- [Texas public adjuster fee calculator](https://enforceinterest.com/tools/public-adjuster-fee-calculator/): Texas public adjuster fee calculator: the 10% cap in Insurance Code §4102.104, what you net and your break-even settlement.
- [ACV and depreciation calculator](https://enforceinterest.com/tools/depreciation-calculator/): Calculate depreciation, actual cash value and recoverable depreciation on an insurance claim, with typical lifespans for roofs and more.
- [Wind and hail deductible calculator](https://enforceinterest.com/tools/wind-hail-deductible-calculator/): Convert a percentage wind/hail or named-storm deductible into dollars and see what a Texas storm claim pays after the deductible and depreciation. Free calculator.
- [Texas judgment interest rate: 7.00%](https://enforceinterest.com/texas-judgment-interest-rate/): The Texas postjudgment interest rate for November 2026 is 7.00% (Fin. Code §304.003). Full OCCC history plus the 12.00% weather-claim rate.
- [Texas prejudgment interest: rules & calculator](https://enforceinterest.com/texas-prejudgment-interest/): Texas prejudgment interest explained: the 180-day accrual rule, the 7.00% rate, settlement offers and §542.060 claims. Free calculator.

## Blog

- [The 18% standard rate, explained](https://enforceinterest.com/blog/18-standard-rate-explained/): How the 18% prompt-payment interest rate in Texas Insurance Code §542.060(a) works: when it applies and starts, the math and partial payments.
- [The Act of God floating rate, explained](https://enforceinterest.com/blog/act-of-god-floating-rate/): The Texas 'Act of God' floating rate on weather claims: §542.060(c), 7.00% + 5% = 12.00%, which claims it covers and the 2017 cutoff.
- [Hinojos v. State Farm Lloyds, explained](https://enforceinterest.com/blog/hinojos-v-state-farm-lloyds-explained/): What the Texas Supreme Court decided in Hinojos v. State Farm Lloyds (2021) and what it means for appraisal and partial payments.
- [Texas insurance claim deadlines: every clock in one place](https://enforceinterest.com/blog/texas-insurance-claim-deadlines/): Every Texas insurance claim deadline in one place: reporting, Chapter 542's 15/15/5/60-day rules, TWIA, 542A notice and limitations.
- [How long do I have to file a freeze claim in Texas?](https://enforceinterest.com/blog/how-long-to-file-a-freeze-claim-in-texas/): How long you have to report and sue on a Texas freeze or burst-pipe claim, freeze exclusions, catastrophe extensions and interest.
- [Smoke damage claims in Texas: investigations, scope and payment](https://enforceinterest.com/blog/smoke-damage-claim-texas/): How Texas smoke damage claims work: smoke damage investigations, disputed scope, wildfire smoke, HVAC and contents, deadlines and interest.
- [The Texas 542A pre-suit notice, explained](https://enforceinterest.com/blog/542a-pre-suit-notice-explained/): What Texas Insurance Code Chapter 542A requires before a weather-claim lawsuit: 61-day notice, contents, inspection and the fee formula.
- [How long must a Texas policy be in force before it can't be canceled?](https://enforceinterest.com/blog/texas-homeowners-insurance-cancellation-rules/): How long must a Texas homeowners policy be in force? The 60-day cancellation rule in §551.104, notice periods and nonrenewal.
